title: Zeus Juice Typhon E-Liquid 50ml Shortfill
description: Typhon by Zeus Juice is an exquisite blend of ripe, tangy raspberries enhanced with a zesty streak of zingy lemon. Those flavours would be delicious by themselves, but a rich, buttery biscuit base makes this fantastic eliquid irresistibly sweet, comforting and indulgent. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vaping mods and sub-ohm tanks .
